headline: Keep {arm:September}: both candidates cost {cost.uplift_range} more per reply, and neither keeps Kairo in character better.
lede: {arm:qwen3.8-flash} is clearly worse in character, down {reading.qwen3.8-flash.change|abs|pts} points, and {arm:1017} is no better than {arm:September}. Only a candidate cheaper than {arm:September} could change the answer, which an earlier round claimed for {arm:qwen3.8-flash} and this run contradicts.
flag: No rule was set in advance: the question, the control and the margin were all set on {late_criteria.set_at}, after the results.

caveats.material_if: Only if the judge underrates both candidates' in-character replies; cost, the deciding finding, is measured, so even then the call becomes a priced trade, not a switch.
Only if a different aspect should have decided this round; cost is measured and does not depend on which aspect was asked.
Only if {arm:September} is not what production serves today, since the call is to keep it.
Only if the simulated user played the candidates' conversations differently from {arm:September}'s; it would touch the character readings, not cost.
Only for whether {arm:1017}'s character loss belongs to the model or to its smaller reasoning share; its higher cost is measured at the share it ran.
Only if a second lever moved with the model on some run; the snapshot names no arm or measure it touches.
Only if {arm:qwen3.8-flash}'s trials lost to the harness, {scoreboard.qwen3.8-flash.lost|int} in all, could close a drop whose interval sits clear of zero; they are too few to.
The same lost trials as the run above, read over a second run; too few to move {arm:qwen3.8-flash}'s reading.

decision.text: Keep {arm:September} in production. At {scoreboard.September.reply_cost_usd|usd_per_1k} it is the cheapest option measured, and neither candidate keeps Kairo in character better.
{arm:qwen3.8-flash}: clearly worse in character, by {reading.qwen3.8-flash.change|abs|pts} points, and it costs {cost.uplift.qwen3.8-flash|pct} more per reply.
{arm:1017}: costs {cost.uplift.1017|pct} more per reply for no gain. Its pass rate is not separated from {arm:September}'s, and on holding character alone it is clearly lower.

An earlier round found {arm:qwen3.8-flash} cheaper than production; this run finds it dearer. Its production cost was recorded on {measure.production_replicating_cost.qwen3.8-flash.n|int} of its {scoreboard.qwen3.8-flash.usable|int} usable trials.
{arm:September} is weak in off-lane asks too, in character on {strata.off_lane.September.persona.holds_character.mean|pct} of them; any future candidate will be read where every option is weakest.
Reconcile {arm:qwen3.8-flash}'s cost with the earlier round before running it again: only a cheaper candidate could reopen this call.

explore.outcome: The call holds at every margin. {arm:qwen3.8-flash}'s verdict turns at {flip_margin.qwen3.8-flash|abs|pts} points and {arm:1017}'s at {flip_margin.1017|abs|pts}, but both cost more either way.

explore.binds: Nothing: no candidate gains a point to price
explore.outcome: It cannot flip. {arm:September} is at least as good on both cost and character as each candidate.

method.text: {cases|int} replayed cases, each run {repeats|int} times on every arm. Intervals are over cases, not attempts.
The campaign does not state what makes a trial pass. For every arm the pass rate is lower than the rate of holding character, so pass is the stricter test.
Readings against the control are at {reading.qwen3.8-flash.level}. Contrasts are corrected together by Holm's method at {family.level}, across {family.family_size|int} comparisons.

The margin lets a candidate's pass rate be up to {aspect.margin|int} points worse. Its floor reads the pass rate for {arm:qwen3.8-flash} but holding character for {arm:1017}; the two are shown separately and neither changes the call.
{judge.model}, calibration tier {judge.tier}: not calibrated against human ratings.
Production cost per reply, replicating what production pays the model, recorded on most but not all trials of each arm. Cost uplift is arithmetic on means and carries no interval.
Latency, read while runs executed concurrently; input tokens, output tokens and model calls, which were not reported.
The frozen evidence of this round, run {meta.run_date}.
